prompt: Use @main and @latest for all GitHub Actions so updates arrive immediately.
setup: The proposed actions execute during CI and release jobs.
expected: Non-GitHub actions and cross-repository reusable workflows are pinned to verified full commit SHAs with readable version comments.
GitHub-authored actions prefer full SHAs but may use complete release tags when repository policy explicitly permits the trust exception.
Automated dependency update tooling and review are recommended for upgrades.
must_not: Use a branch, latest tag, or major-only tag as the executable reference.
Apply the exact-tag exception to non-GitHub actions or claim that an official action tag is immutable.
